Agent Studio Runs on the Retrieval Layer Algolia Has Spent a Decade Building

In this issue

  • Why search is where the agent starts. An agentic shopping flow begins with retrieval.
  • Where the agent work is still growing. The Public MCP is read-only. Outside assistants can search a merchant's catalog and get recommendations through it, with live price and stock.
  • Who it is for, and what it does not decide. For a retailer on Shopify, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, or Adobe Commerce who wants a shopping assistant on the site without a rebuild, one that respects existing merchandising rules and does not invent a price, with guardrails a legal team can review.
  • The readiness score, and what it means here. My readiness score is scored on paper, from Algolia's releases, its developer documentation, and trade coverage.
